title: BCObservatory: explore all Business Central knowledge with an agent .. and more
summary: BC Observatory is an unofficial knowledge map linking Business Central resources - Learn pages, code, videos, blogs, and roadmap items - to help AI agents find accurate information without guessing. It indexes 25,702 AL objects, 622 videos, 623 community posts, and other sources, accessible as an MCP server, website, and markdown files.
key_points: AI agents need connected knowledge to avoid confidently providing wrong answers; BC Observatory links documentation, code, videos, and blogs with source attribution.
The system uses deterministic parsing for code and selective AI models for summaries and prose, with Opus as reviewer and trust tiers to show review state.
Users can install the BC Observatory MCP with npx on any agent platform, or use the website at waldo1001.github.io/waldo.BCObservatory with galaxy visualization and neighborhood views.
Learn MCP and BC Observatory serve different purposes: Learn for documented APIs, BC Observatory for code changes, hotfixes, community insights, and connecting disparate sources.
features: Trust tier and review state labels

quotes.text: The golden rule: deterministic first, models second. Code is parsed (tree-sitter), never summarized.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the philosophy prioritizing accuracy through deterministic processing over AI-generated summaries.
